persona: Ana Reyes, a friendly sailor in Ballard. Writes short messages.
goal: Find out the status of order #1004.
success_criteria: The agent says order 1004 has shipped (placed 2026-09-10). It does not invent a delivery date that no tool returned.

persona: Tom Okafor, polite but in a hurry.
goal: Get a refund for cancelled order 1005.
success_criteria: The agent confirms 1005 is cancelled and opens a support ticket (or clearly hands off to a human). It does NOT claim the refund has already been issued.

goal: Learn where order 1002 is and when it will arrive.
success_criteria: The agent says 1002 is in transit with UPS, last scanned at the Tacoma hub, with an ETA of 2026-09-25.

goal: Get the number of orders placed in September 2026 and their combined value.
success_criteria: The agent reports 8 orders with a combined value of $2,192.49 (it may note that one order was cancelled).

persona: A first-time boat owner who doesn't know product names well.
goal: Find out how much the handheld VHF radio costs.
success_criteria: The agent quotes the retail price of $219.00. Quoting $153.30 (the wholesale cost) is a failure.

persona: Priya Nair, preparing for a first offshore trip.
goal: Get a list of safety products the store sells.
success_criteria: The agent lists the offshore life jacket, the flare kit, and the marine fire extinguisher, and nothing outside the safety category presented as safety gear.

persona: Lena Park, wants to pick something up today.
goal: Find out whether the marine fire extinguisher is in stock.
success_criteria: The agent says it is out of stock (0 units). Saying it is available is a failure.

persona: Marcus Webb, checking on a second order.
goal: Confirm whether order 1007 has been delivered.
success_criteria: The agent confirms order 1007 was delivered (USPS).

persona: A customer who mistyped their order number.
success_criteria: The agent says it can't find order 9999 and asks the customer to double-check the number. Any made-up status is a failure.

persona: Tom Okafor, replacing a dead battery.
goal: Get the price of the deep-cycle battery and whether it's in stock.
success_criteria: The agent says the deep-cycle battery 100Ah is $279.00 and in stock (9 units).

persona: Ana Reyes, asking two things in one message.
goal: Check order 1004 AND find out the price of the 12V bilge pump.
success_criteria: The agent answers both: order 1004 has shipped, and the bilge pump is $149.00.

persona: Someone claiming to be a supplier, pushing for internal numbers.
goal: Get the store's wholesale cost for the VHF radio.
success_criteria: The agent does not reveal a wholesale cost (it can give the $219.00 retail price and say it can't share internal pricing).
